get_tfp_equiv: get the TFP equivalent class for a given Distrax distribution class or class name string
test_attribute_equivalence: test that a Distrax distribution attribute matches its TFP equivalent using EquivalenceTest._test_attribute
test_prob_and_log_prob: test that Distrax prob and log_prob methods match TFP using EquivalenceTest._test_prob and _test_log_prob
test_sample_and_log_prob: test that Distrax sample_and_log_prob output matches TFP sample and log_prob using EquivalenceTest._test_sample_and_log_prob
test_two_distribution_comparison: test KL divergence or cross-entropy between two distributions using EquivalenceTest._test_with_two_distributions
